component.name: Sober Shader Manager
component.summary: Manage and launch vkBasalt shader chains with Sober

description.p: A launcher and config manager for running vkBasalt shader packs with Sober (the Roblox Flatpak) on Fedora ostree desktops.
It detects vkBasalt compatibility, manages shader configurations, and applies them with automatic rollback if a shader fails to load.
